Keep in sync with project_isa_watchlist.md and project_isa_trades_log.md. ENERGY candidates promoted to watchlist from energy_screener use source_pipeline='energy' and path='C'. update_watchlist.py owns promotion/ranking logic and all score_history/normalised_score updates.
